_note: Notable events of the setting, paraphrased. `sort` is an approximate year key: (millennium - 1) * 1000 + year, so 999.M41 is 40999. Dates differ between editions and sources; `date` gives the commonly cited form, with 'c.' where the sources disagree or are vague. `books` lists Black Library titles that depict or refer to the event.

ages.name: Before Mankind
ages.blurb: The War in Heaven, the Necrontyr and the Old Ones, aeons before humanity.

ages.name: Dark Age and Age of Strife
ages.blurb: Humanity's golden age of technology, then the warp storms and the long collapse.

ages.name: The Great Crusade
ages.blurb: The Emperor and his Primarchs reconquer the galaxy for humanity.

ages.name: The Horus Heresy
ages.blurb: Half the Legions follow the Warmaster in rebellion against the Emperor.

ages.name: The Age of the Imperium
ages.blurb: Ten thousand years of the Emperor on the Golden Throne.

ages.name: The Time of Ending
ages.blurb: The last century of M41: hive fleets, Black Crusades and waking tombs.

ages.name: The Era Indomitus
ages.blurb: The Great Rift splits the galaxy and the Avenging Son returns.

events.name: The War in Heaven
events.summary: The Necrontyr, embittered by their short lives, made war on the ancient Old Ones and took the star-gods called the C'tan as allies. The price was biotransference: the Necrontyr's flesh was burned away and their souls bound into living metal. After the war the Necrons entered the Great Sleep in their tomb worlds, waking only now.

events.name: The Dark Age of Technology
events.summary: Humanity spread across the galaxy using Standard Template Constructs and thinking machines, reaching a height of technology it has never regained. The age ended with the revolt of the Men of Iron and the first stirrings of the human psyker.

events.name: The Age of Strife
events.summary: Warp storms cut the human worlds off from one another for five thousand years. Terra fell to warring techno-barbarians, Mars turned inward to become the Cult of the Machine, and countless colonies were lost or forgotten.

events.name: The Fall of the Aeldari
events.summary: The excesses of the Aeldari empire gave birth to Slaanesh. Its scream tore open the Eye of Terror over the Aeldari heartlands and devoured almost the whole race in an instant. The survivors fled on the craftworlds or as Exodites, and the dead worlds left behind are the crone worlds inside the Eye.

events.name: The Unification Wars
events.summary: The Emperor revealed himself and conquered the warring nations of Terra with his gene-crafted Thunder Warriors, ending the Age of Strife on humanity's birthworld.

events.name: The Treaty of Olympus
events.summary: The Emperor and the Fabricator General of Mars bound Terra and the Red Planet together. The Mechanicum would arm the Great Crusade and its Titan Legions would march beside the Emperor's, in return for autonomy and the recognition of the Machine God.

events.name: The Great Crusade begins
events.summary: With Terra and Mars united, the Emperor led the Legiones Astartes out into the galaxy to reclaim the lost worlds of humanity, and to find his scattered sons, the Primarchs.

events.name: Horus found on Cthonia
events.summary: The first Primarch to be reunited with the Emperor grew up among the gangs of the mined-out world of Cthonia. Horus took command of the Luna Wolves, and Cthonia became the recruiting ground of his Legion.

events.name: Guilliman reunited with the Emperor
events.summary: The Emperor found Roboute Guilliman as master of Macragge, adopted son of its consul. Guilliman took the Ultramarines and built the Five Hundred Worlds of Ultramar into a realm within the Imperium.

events.name: The Censure of Monarchia
events.summary: Lorgar's Word Bearers raised the city of Monarchia on Khur as a cathedral to the Emperor as a god. The Emperor had the Ultramarines raze it, and made the Word Bearers kneel in its ashes. Lorgar's devotion turned to the gods of Chaos.

events.name: The destruction of Nostramo
events.summary: Konrad Curze turned the guns of the Night Lords fleet on his own homeworld, a lightless world he had once ruled through terror, and broke it apart.

events.name: The Ullanor Crusade
events.summary: The Emperor and Horus broke the Ork empire of Urlakk Urg, the greatest greenskin realm of the age. At the Ullanor Triumph that followed, the Emperor returned to Terra and named Horus Warmaster in his place.

events.name: The compliance of Sixty-Three Nineteen
events.summary: Horus's first campaign as Warmaster: a lost human empire that believed itself the true Imperium. Garviel Loken's battle in its high city opens the Horus Heresy series.

events.name: The war on Murder
events.summary: The Luna Wolves fought beside Sanguinius's Blood Angels to exterminate the Megarachnid of Murder, a world where an earlier expedition had been lost.

events.name: The Council of Nikaea
events.summary: The Emperor convened a council over the use of psychic powers. The Edict of Nikaea disbanded the Librarius of every Legion and censured Magnus the Red, who would soon break the edict to warn his father of Horus's treachery.

events.name: The Webway War
events.summary: Beneath the Imperial Palace the Emperor fought a secret war to hold open his Imperial Webway. Magnus's psychic warning shattered its wards and let the daemons in.

events.name: Horus falls on Davin
events.summary: Wounded by the cursed anathame on Davin's moon, Horus was carried to the Delphos temple of Davin's lodges. There the Chaos gods showed him a future in which he was forgotten and the Emperor worshipped, and Horus turned.

events.name: The Isstvan III Atrocity
events.summary: Horus virus-bombed Isstvan III to murder the loyalists within his own four Legions. Some survived the bombardment and fought on in the ruins; Nathaniel Garro's frigate Eisenstein escaped to carry the warning to Terra.

events.name: The Burning of Prospero
events.summary: Leman Russ was sent to bring Magnus to Terra. Horus twisted the order into a death sentence, and the Space Wolves, Custodes and Sisters of Silence razed the city of Tizca. Magnus led his Thousand Sons into the warp.

events.name: The Signus Campaign
events.summary: Horus sent Sanguinius and the Blood Angels to the Signus Cluster, where daemons waited for them. The Legion faced the Red Thirst and the temptation of Ka'Bandha, and was kept from Isstvan V.

events.name: The Schism of Mars
events.summary: Fabricator General Kelbor-Hal sided with Horus and turned Mars on itself. Loyal and traitor forges fought across the Red Planet, and the Dark Mechanicum was born.

events.name: The Drop Site Massacre
events.summary: Seven Legions landed on Isstvan V to punish Horus. Four of them turned their guns on the Iron Hands, Salamanders and Raven Guard. Ferrus Manus died at Fulgrim's hand, and the three loyal Legions were all but destroyed.

events.name: The Damnation of Pythos
events.summary: Iron Hands survivors of Isstvan V took refuge on the death world Pythos, only to find its refugees drawn into a cult that opened the world to the warp.

events.name: The Battle of Calth
events.summary: The Word Bearers fell on the Ultramarines at Calth while the two Legions were mustering together. The Word Bearers poisoned Calth's star and made the surface unlivable, and the war went on for years in the arcology caverns below: the Underworld War.

events.name: The Shadow Crusade
events.summary: The Word Bearers and World Eaters swept through Ultramar while Calth burned. Lorgar's rituals culminated in Angron's ascension to daemonhood, and the Ruinstorm cut the eastern galaxy off from Terra.

events.name: Imperium Secundus
events.summary: Believing Terra lost behind the Ruinstorm, Guilliman built a second Imperium around Macragge and crowned Sanguinius its emperor. When the truth reached them, the experiment was abandoned.

events.name: The Pharos of Sotha
events.summary: The Night Lords struck Sotha to seize the Pharos, a xenos beacon in the mountain that shone across the Ruinstorm and guided Imperium Secundus. Sotha's Ultramarines fought to deny it to them.

events.name: The Battle of Tallarn
events.summary: The Iron Warriors virus-bombed Tallarn, killing every living thing on the surface. The survivors fought from sealed bunkers in the largest armoured battle in human history, while Perturabo hunted for something buried beneath the sands.

events.name: The Fall of Molech
events.summary: Horus led the Sons of Horus against the Knight world of Molech to reach a gateway the Emperor had once used, and took the power he found there for himself.

events.name: The Battle of Beta-Garmon
events.summary: At the gateway to the Segmentum Solar, loyalist and traitor Titan Legions met in the largest engagement of god-machines ever fought. Billions died, but the traitors broke through to Terra.

events.name: The Siege of Terra
events.summary: The traitor host fought its way through the Solar System and besieged the Imperial Palace. In the end the Emperor boarded Horus's flagship and slew his son, but was so badly wounded that he was entombed in the Golden Throne, where he has lain ever since.

events.name: The Fall of Caliban
events.summary: When the Lion returned home, Luther and the Dark Angels left on Caliban turned on him. Caliban was torn apart in the fighting, and all that survived was the fortress-monastery that became the Rock. The Dark Angels have hunted the Fallen in secret ever since.

events.name: The death of Konrad Curze
events.summary: On Tsagualsa, the Night Lords' fortress world on the Eastern Fringe, the Callidus assassin M'Shen killed Konrad Curze. He had foreseen it and let her do it. Ten thousand years later the Night Lords return to the place where their father died.

events.name: The Great Scouring
events.summary: The loyalists drove the Traitor Legions out of the Imperium. Most fled into the Eye of Terror, where they carved out daemon worlds like Medrengard and Sicarus.

events.name: The Second Founding
events.summary: Guilliman's Codex Astartes broke the Legions into Chapters of a thousand warriors, so that no single commander could ever again lead a Legion against the Imperium.

events.name: The Rubric of Ahriman
events.summary: To halt the mutations ravaging the Thousand Sons, Ahriman cast a great spell. It turned most of the Legion into dust sealed inside their armour, the Rubric Marines. Magnus exiled him for it.

events.name: The Legion Wars
events.summary: Inside the Eye, the Traitor Legions turned on one another. The Sons of Horus were broken and their gene-seed stolen, and Abaddon forged the Black Legion from the wreckage.

events.name: The First Black Crusade
events.summary: Abaddon led the Black Legion out of the Eye for the first time. It was the first of thirteen assaults on the Cadian Gate.

events.name: The War of the Beast
events.summary: An Ork empire of unprecedented cunning attacked the Imperium. Its gargants and attack moons nearly annihilated the Imperial Fists, and an Ork moon hung in the skies over Terra.

events.name: The Battle of the Fang
events.summary: Magnus and the Thousand Sons came for vengeance on Fenris and besieged the Fang, the Space Wolves' fortress-mountain, while most of the Wolves were far away.

events.name: The Age of Apostasy
events.summary: High Lord Goge Vandire seized both the Administratum and the Ecclesiarchy and ruled as a tyrant: the Reign of Blood. It ended when the Brides of the Emperor, later the Adepta Sororitas, learned the truth and turned on him.

events.name: The Gothic War
events.summary: Abaddon swept into the Gothic Sector to seize the ancient Blackstone Fortresses. Years of naval war followed, fought between the fleets across the sector's stars.

events.name: The Eyclone affair
events.summary: Inquisitor Gregor Eisenhorn hunted the heretic Murdin Eyclone from the frozen world of Hubris across the Helican subsector. The trail led to a cabal seeking the Necroteuch.

events.name: The Great Triumph massacre
events.summary: A psychic atrocity during a victory parade on Thracian Primaris drew Eisenhorn into a conspiracy that reached into the Inquisition itself.

events.name: The Macharian Crusade
events.summary: Lord Solar Macharius conquered a thousand worlds in seven years, pushing beyond the western edge of the Imperium. After his death the conquest fell apart in the Macharian Heresy.

events.name: Ravenor on Eustis Majoris
events.summary: Inquisitor Gideon Ravenor, Eisenhorn's crippled former pupil, traced the drug flects through the stacked hive of Petropolis. It led to a daemon-tainted conspiracy across the Angelus subsector.

events.name: The Atonement of Krieg
events.summary: When Krieg's Autarch renounced the Emperor, Colonel Jurten of the loyal regiments answered with nuclear fire. Five hundred years of atomic civil war followed, until the world was a poisoned wasteland. Its people still seek to atone with their lives.

events.name: The Bequin inquiry
events.summary: Alizebeth Bequin, a blank in the city of Queen Mab, found herself pulled between Eisenhorn, Ravenor and the cults of the King in Yellow.

events.name: The Damocles Gulf Crusade
events.summary: The Imperium's first great war on the young T'au Empire. The crusade reached the sept world of Dal'yth, but Hive Fleet Behemoth approaching from the east forced a truce, and the T'au kept everything they held.

events.name: The First Tyrannic War
events.summary: Hive Fleet Behemoth came out of the intergalactic dark. Its first victim was the outpost world of Tyran, whose dying warning reached Macragge. At the Battle of Macragge the Ultramarines' entire First Company died holding the polar fortresses, but Behemoth was destroyed.

events.name: The Sabbat Worlds Crusade
events.summary: Warmaster Slaydo launched a crusade to free the Sabbat Worlds, the cluster of Saint Sabbat, from Chaos. He fell in the victory at Balhaut, and Macaroth carried the war on. It lasted for decades.

events.name: The Fall of Tanith
events.summary: Tanith was destroyed by Chaos on the night its regiments were founded. Commissar Ibram Gaunt pulled the survivors offworld, and the Tanith First and Only became the Ghosts.

events.name: The Fortis Binary campaign
events.summary: On the forge world Fortis Binary the Ghosts first fought through the trenches, then followed the trail to Menazoid Epsilon and an STC that a Lord General was willing to kill for.

events.name: The Siege of Vervunhive
events.summary: The Zoican War: one hive of Verghast, Ferrozoica, fell to Chaos and besieged its neighbour Vervunhive. The Ghosts held the hive, and Verghastite survivors joined the regiment.

events.name: The relics of Saint Sabbat
events.summary: The Ghosts were sent to carry the relics of Saint Sabbat out of her shrine on Hagia before the enemy could take them.

events.name: The liberation of Phantine
events.summary: The Ghosts dropped by grav-chute into the spire cities above Phantine's toxic cloud sea, while the Phantine Fighter Corps fought for the skies.

events.name: The Aexe War
events.summary: Trench warfare between the Aexe Alliance and the Shadik Republic, with the Ghosts sent forward through the forests ahead of the lines.

events.name: The Beati on Herodor
events.summary: A woman hailed as Saint Sabbat returned, the Beati, rallied the defenders of the shrine world Herodor against a Chaos assault.

events.name: The occupation of Gereon
events.summary: Gaunt led a small team onto the occupied world of Gereon to kill a captured Imperial general before he could betray the crusade. The Ghosts later returned in force to liberate the world.

events.name: The storming of Ancreon Sextus
events.summary: The Ghosts stormed the great ziggurat-hives of Ancreon Sextus, a shrine world held by the enemy.

events.name: The siege of Hinzerhaus
events.summary: On the bleak world of Jago the Ghosts held Hinzerhaus, a fortress cut into the rock, against an endless enemy, with the fortress itself haunting them.

events.name: The battle for Urdesh
events.summary: The forge world Urdesh became the centre of the crusade's endgame. Warmaster Macaroth, the Ghosts and the Sons of Sek fought for it while the crusade's fate hung in the balance.

events.name: The Siege of Vraks
events.summary: Cardinal Xaphan led the armoury world of Vraks Prime into heresy. The Death Korps of Krieg spent seventeen years of attrition taking it back, trench by trench.

events.name: The Farsight Expedition
events.summary: Commander Farsight led an expedition across the Damocles Gulf. On Arthas Moloch, a world of strange ruins, he took up the Dawn Blade. He broke with the Ethereals and founded the Farsight Enclaves.

events.name: The Badab War
events.summary: Lufgt Huron, Chapter Master of the Astral Claws and Tyrant of Badab, defied the Imperium over the tithe and drew other Chapters into a secession. When the loyalists broke him he fled into the Maelstrom, and the Astral Claws became the Red Corsairs.

events.name: Cain on Gravalax
events.summary: Commissar Ciaphas Cain, Hero of the Imperium, kept two Guard regiments from each other's throats and uncovered a genestealer cult stirring trouble between the Imperium and the T'au.

events.name: The caves of Simia Orichalcae
events.summary: Cain and the Valhallan 597th fought Orks on the ice world of Simia Orichalcae, then found something far older waking in the mines.

events.name: The Adumbria crisis
events.summary: On the tidally locked world of Adumbria Cain faced a Chaos cult and a plot against the Imperial command.

events.name: The long march across Perlia
events.summary: Cut off behind Ork lines, Cain gathered stragglers into an improvised army and led it across the war-torn world.

events.name: The Second War for Armageddon
events.summary: Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka led his first Waaagh! onto Armageddon. Commissar Yarrick held Hades Hive until the Space Marines arrived, and Ghazghkull escaped with an obsession with the old man who had beaten him.

events.name: The Rynn's World incident
events.summary: Waaagh! Snagrod struck Rynn's World. A misfiring missile destroyed the Crimson Fists' fortress-monastery and most of the Chapter in a single blow. The survivors fought on until relief came.

events.name: The fall of Iyanden
events.summary: Hive Fleet Kraken fell on Iyanden. The craftworld survived only because the exiled Prince Yriel came back to save it, and so many died that Iyanden now fights largely with the dead in wraithbone bodies.

events.name: The Battle for Ichar IV
events.summary: A tendril of Hive Fleet Kraken assaulted the hive world of Ichar IV. Space Marines of several Chapters, led by the Ultramarines, met it in one of the hardest-fought Tyranid wars of the age.

events.name: The siege of Hydra Cordatus
events.summary: An Iron Warriors warband under the Warsmith besieged the citadel of Hydra Cordatus, a secret gene-seed repository. Honsou, a half-breed captain, rose through the siege.

events.name: The Nightbringer on Pavonis
events.summary: Captain Uriel Ventris of the Ultramarines came to the troubled world of Pavonis, where cartel feuds and Eldar raiders masked something worse: the C'tan shard called the Nightbringer stirring in its tomb. He would later return to defend Pavonis again.

events.name: The defence of Tarsis Ultra
events.summary: The Ultramarines and Mortifactors held the ice world of Tarsis Ultra against a Tyranid hive fleet, through a siege fought in the frozen hive-city.

events.name: Uriel Ventris's Death Oath
events.summary: Exiled for breaking the Codex, Uriel Ventris and Pasanius went into the Eye of Terror to destroy the daemon engine the Iron Warriors used to breed their warriors on Medrengard. The Iron Warriors' Honsou was there.

events.name: Return from the Eye at Salinas
events.summary: Back in real space, Uriel and Pasanius came to Salinas and faced the Grey Knights' suspicion along with the world's own buried horrors.

events.name: The Siege of Castellax
events.summary: The Iron Warriors held the world of Castellax and its slave labour against an Ork Waaagh!, fighting with the cold cruelty of the Legion.

events.name: The siege of Orestes
events.summary: Chaos fell on the forge world Orestes, and the Titans of the Legio Invicta came to its relief, the war of god-machines told in Titanicus.

events.name: Deus Encarmine
events.summary: The Blood Angels fought the Word Bearers on Shenlong. What followed tore at the Chapter, as Rafen's brother Arkio was hailed as Sanguinius reborn.

events.name: The Fall of Damnos
events.summary: The Necrons beneath the Imperial mining world of Damnos woke. The Ultramarines fought them and could only cover the evacuation. They later returned to take the world back.

events.name: The Valedor campaign
events.summary: The craftworlds Iyanden and Biel-Tan made a hard alliance to keep Hive Fleet Leviathan from the maiden world of Valedor, at a terrible cost.

events.name: The Third War for Armageddon
events.summary: Ghazghkull returned with the greatest Ork horde in Imperial memory. Yarrick and dozens of Space Marine Chapters fought across the hives and ash wastes. At Helsreach Hive the Black Templars held on to the last.

events.name: The plots of Commorragh
events.summary: In the Dark City, the archon Yllithian schemed to bring back El'Uriaq, a lost Drukhari emperor, and topple Asdrubael Vect. Vect had expected him.

events.name: The Mont'ka of Agrellan
events.summary: In the second Damocles war, the T'au under Shadowsun and an Imperial counter-crusade of White Scars, Raven Guard and Ultramarines fought for the Damocles Gulf. Agrellan was the turning point.

events.name: The Fall of Cadia
events.summary: Abaddon's Thirteenth Black Crusade broke the Cadian Gate. Cadia held for weeks, the Saint Celestine at its side, until Abaddon crashed a Blackstone Fortress into the planet. The fortress world split apart, and its survivors swore Cadia stands while they live.

events.name: The Great Rift opens
events.summary: As Cadia died, a chain of warp storms tore across the galaxy from the Eye of Terror to the Hadex Anomaly: the Cicatrix Maledictum. Half the Imperium, Imperium Nihilus, lost sight of the Astronomican.

events.name: The Fracture of Biel-Tan
events.summary: A bid to grow the Infinity Circuit broke Biel-Tan's heart and nearly destroyed the craftworld. In the ruin, the Visarch and Yvraine rose as heralds of Ynnead, the god of the dead, and the Ynnari were born.

events.name: The return of Roboute Guilliman
events.summary: Woken from ten thousand years of stasis by the Ynnari and Archmagos Cawl, Guilliman fought his way to Terra through the storms and stood before the Golden Throne. He was named Lord Commander of the Imperium.

events.name: The Devastation of Baal
events.summary: Hive Fleet Leviathan surrounded the Blood Angels' home system. Commander Dante gathered the Sons of Sanguinius for a last stand on Baal, and the system was saved when the warp storms of the opening Great Rift swept the hive fleet away.

events.name: The Indomitus Crusade
events.summary: Guilliman launched a crusade across the shattered Imperium with the first of the Primaris Space Marines. Its fleets fought to relink Imperium Sanctus and to push into Imperium Nihilus.

events.name: The Plague Wars
events.summary: Mortarion and the Death Guard fell on Ultramar, turning the garden world of Iax into a plague-sodden ruin and testing Guilliman's realm to the breaking point.

events.name: The War of Vigilus
events.summary: Vigilus guards the Nachmund Gauntlet, one of the few safe crossings of the Great Rift. Orks, a genestealer uprising and Abaddon's own forces all fought to break it.
